cs.t: Maybe just make it one row wider or taller so that it can have an escape and  a `~ key simultaneously?  The need to make these things so small that compromises like having to choose between esc and `~ is very strange to me.   This is not a portable device. I have had a Mistel MD650L for the last 6 weeks, and I didn't notice that it had the same issue as this one -- you need to press a mod key to switch between esc and `~.   I use both enough that this is a major PITA.   I remapped the "del" key to `~ for a while, but then I started to have to hunt around for that key on my laptop.
